title: The binding mechanism of NHWD-870 to bromodomain-containing protein 4 based on molecular dynamics simulations and free energy calculation.
authors: Shi, Mingsong; He, Jun; Weng, Tiantian; Shi, Na; Qi, Wenyan; Guo, Yong; Chen, Tao; Chen, Lijuan; Xu, Dingguo
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小分子NHWD-870与溴结构域蛋白BRD4的结合机制，属于蛋白-小分子互作，而非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题TF-DNA结合机制无关。
abstract: Bromodomain and extra-terminal (BET) proteins (BRD2, BRD3, BRD4, and BRDT) are epigenetic readers with tandem bromodomains. Small-molecule inhibitors of BET proteins are a promising treatment strategy against cancer. For example, NHWD-870 can inhibit BRD4 (BD1 + BD2). Presently, structural data on NHWD-870 bound BRD4 remain lacking. Herein, we investigate the interactions between NHWD-870 and BRD4 (BD1 and BD2) via molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulation, and binding free energy calculations. NHWD-870 showed a similar binding affinity for BD1 and BD2 of BRD4. Binding free energy calculations for the R/S conformations of NHWD-870 suggest that the chiral centre of NHWD-870 may confer similar roles upon the R and S conformations for binding with BRD4, facilitating the identification of novel BRD4 inhibitors.
abstract_zh: 溴结构域和末端外（BET）蛋白（BRD2、BRD3、BRD4 和 BRDT）是具有串联溴结构域的表观遗传读取器。BET 蛋白的小分子抑制剂是治疗癌症的一种有前景的策略。例如，NHWD-870 可以抑制 BRD4（BD1 + BD2）。目前，关于 NHWD-870 与 BRD4 结合的结构数据仍然缺乏。在此，我们通过分子对接、分子动力学模拟和结合自由能计算，研究了 NHWD-870 与 BRD4（BD1 和 BD2）之间的相互作用。NHWD-870 对 BRD4 的 BD1 和 BD2 表现出相似的结合亲和力。对 NHWD-870 的 R/S 构象进行的结合自由能计算表明，NHWD-870 的手性中心可能赋予 R 和 S 构象在与 BRD4 结合时相似的作用，从而有助于识别新型 BRD4 抑制剂。
